name: Marinated Tofu Sandwiches

ingredients.name: chile powder, such as Kashmiri or Guntur Sannam
seeded whole-grain sandwich bread, such as Dave's Killer Bread

instructions.primary_message: Cut the extra-firm tofu into 10 slabs about 1/2-inch thick. Grate the garlic. Mash the avocado. Slice the unpeeled English cucumber into 1/8-inch thick rounds. Thinly slice the jarred roasted red peppers.
instructions.secondary_message:
396 g extra-firm tofu
3 medium cloves garlic
1 medium Avocado
¼ unpeeled English cucumber
3 to 4 jarred roasted red peppers

instructions.primary_message: To dry tofu, line a 9-by-33-cm rimmed baking sheet with paper towels. Place tofu slices on top in a single layer. Cover with another layer of paper towels and press gently to remove excess moisture.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, garlic, chile powder, and black pepper.
Remove paper towels from tofu. Pour marinade over tofu, tossing to evenly coat tofu in sauce. Let sit, refrigerated, for at least 30 minutes and up to 8 hours.

When ready to assemble, adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line a 13-by-46-cm rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. If using foil, lightly grease with oil. Arrange tofu in a single layer on sheet pan and bake, flipping halfway through, until the edges are browned, crispy, and chewy, 10 to 15 minutes. (The slices will look dark from the balsamic and soy. This is OK!)

To Toast Bread: Using oven mitts or kitchen towels, adjust oven rack to upper-third position, about 15-cm from broiler. Heat broiler. Arrange bread slices on a 9- by 33-cm rimmed baking sheet. Broil, flipping halfway through, until bread is light golden brown on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes. (See notes.)

To Assemble: Lay toasted bread on a work surface and, using a butter knife or offset spatula, spread mayonnaise on bottom slices and Dijon mustard on top slices. Top each bottom slice with 2 to 3 tablespoons mashed avocado, spreading evenly to coat from edge to edge, then layer sliced cucumber and roasted red peppers on top. Season generously with salt and pepper. Add 2 to 3 slices of tofu, followed by pickled onions and sprouts. Close sandwich and cut in half diagonally. Repeat with remaining sandwiches. Serve immediately.

description: This marinated tofu sandwich is savory, tangy, and sweet. Loaded with early-2000s sandwich shop favorites, including alfalfa sprouts, avocado, and cucumber, it's large and in charge—and incredibly satisfying to eat.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 13 min.

Optional or for serving: Vegan mayonnaise (optional)

Notes: If assembling just 1 or 2 sandwiches, bread can be toasted in a toaster.

Make-ahead and storage: Once cooled, baked tofu can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
author: Antara Sinha
